title: Worked Cases on Charges Paid Up Front with a Payment Plan Down Payment
content:
On an Apartment Home Lease payment plan, some charges are paid up front in full with the down payment rather than spread:

- a lease with a returned payment in the last 12 months pays up front the returned payment fees dated in the last 12 months and the late fees of the most recent late billing period;
- a lease with no returned payment in the last 12 months and initial late fee lines in two or more billing periods in the last 12 months pays up front the late fees of the most recent late billing period;
- any other lease pays nothing up front.

**Terms.** The late fees of a period are its late fee lines less the charge reversal and courtesy waiver credits posted for that period, never below zero. The most recent late billing period is the billing period of the latest initial late fee line. A returned payment is any payment return on the lease ledger, whatever its reason. The last 12 months means dated after the same day of the month twelve months before the day of signing.

## Case grid

| Payment return in the last 12 months | Billing periods with an initial late fee line in the last 12 months | Paid up front |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | any | returned payment fees of the last 12 months, plus the late fees of the most recent late billing period |
| No | 2 or more | the late fees of the most recent late billing period |
| No | 0 or 1 | nothing |

## Worked cases (hypothetical, day of signing 15 July 2026)

Most recent late billing period: late fee lines $172.00, a charge reversal credit of $28.00 posted for it, no courtesy waiver — its late fees are $144.00.

| Ledger history | Paid up front |
|---|---|
| A payment returned on 3 February 2026 with a returned payment fee line of $40.00 dated 4 February 2026 | $40.00 plus $144.00: $184.00 |
| No return; initial late fee lines in March 2026 and June 2026 | $144.00 |
| No return; one initial late fee line, in June 2026 | $0.00 |
| A payment returned on 10 July 2025 (outside the last 12 months); initial late fee line only in June 2026 | $0.00 |
